achievements.name: Settlement
achievements.description: Reach a population of 300 citizens.

achievements.name: Village
achievements.description: Reach a population of 600 citizens.

achievements.name: Town
achievements.description: Reach a population of 900 citizens.

achievements.name: Educated
achievements.description: Have a fully educated population with 200 adults for 4 years.

achievements.name: Uneducated
achievements.description: Reach a population of 300 citizens without building schools.

achievements.name: Jack of all Trades
achievements.description: Build a town of over 200 people that has someone working in every profession for at least 5 years.

achievements.name: Mountain Men
achievements.description: Using a harsh climate and a small mountainous map, maintain a population of 50 people for 20 years.

achievements.name: Tombstone
achievements.description: Fill graveyards with at least 400 graves.

achievements.name: Blacksmith
achievements.description: Equip a population of over 200 adults with steel tools for 4 years.

achievements.name: Stylish
achievements.description: Cloth a population of over 200 with warm coats for 4 years.

achievements.name: Isolationist
achievements.description: Reach 300 citizens without building a trading post.

achievements.name: One with Nature
achievements.description: Reach 400 citizens without building crops fields, orchards, or pastures.

achievements.name: Trader
achievements.description: Use trading posts to trade 50,000 units of goods in a single town.

achievements.name: Master Trader
achievements.description: Use trading posts to trade 100,000 units of goods in a single town.

achievements.name: Exports
achievements.description: Stock the trading post with at least 500 ale, 300 steel tools, and 200 warm coats.

achievements.name: Firefighter
achievements.description: Build 20 wells in a single town.

achievements.name: Farmer
achievements.description: Acquire 3 livestock types, 8 crop seed types, and 8 orchard seed types.

achievements.name: Livestock
achievements.description: Build a town that contains 60 cattle, 75 sheep, and 180 chickens.

achievements.name: Food Variety
achievements.description: Grow and harvest 8 different plants and 8 different orchard tree types in a single year.

achievements.name: Miner
achievements.description: Maintain 2 mines with 30 workers each for 3 years.

achievements.name: Mason
achievements.description: Maintain 2 quarries with 30 workers each for 3 years.

achievements.name: Foodie
achievements.description: In a single year, produce at least 2000 food each from hunters, gatherers, fisherman, pastures, fields, and orchards.

achievements.name: Lumberjack
achievements.description: Produce 50,000 logs within a 100 year period.

achievements.name: Stonework
achievements.description: Produce 10,000 stone within a 100 year period.

achievements.name: Smelter
achievements.description: Produce 10,000 iron within a 100 year period.

achievements.name: Highwaymen
achievements.description: Build a town with 2000 stone paved road tiles.

achievements.name: Golden Gate
achievements.description: Build a bridge that is at least 50 units long.

achievements.name: Immigrants
achievements.description: Allow 200 nomads into a single town.

achievements.name: Smiles all Around
achievements.description: Maintain high happiness for 10 years in a town with at least 100 citizens.

achievements.name: Healthy
achievements.description: Maintain high health for 10 years in a town with at least 100 citizens.

achievements.name: Built from Stone
achievements.description: Build a town with 100 stone houses.

achievements.name: Ready for Anything
achievements.description: Simultaneously store 2000 fuel, 2000 wood, 500 stone, 500 iron, 200 tools, 200 coats, and 30000 food.

achievements.name: Builder
achievements.description: Build a town that has at least one of every possible structure.

achievements.name: Master Builder
achievements.description: Build a town with 3 churches, 5 boarding houses, 4 markets, 5 hospitals, 2 trading posts, 6 taverns, and a town hall.

achievements.name: Established
achievements.description: Build a town that has a population of 300 after 100 years.

achievements.name: Tenure
achievements.description: Build a town that has a population of 500 after 200 years.
